The '''Administrative Droid AD-12''' was a three-legged [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A number of AD-12 droids oversaw operations in the [[Okara Droid Factory]].
